picks.title: Beyond 2 Pro Bluetooth OTC Hearing Aids, 39% Clearer Speech
feature_bullets: VocClear 3.0 Keeps Speech in Front - Target speech enhancement lifts the voice you're listening to out of a busy room, while upgraded feedback suppression helps these hearing aids cut the whistling when you hug someone or put on a hat. It runs by itself and keeps adjusting as the room changes

Light Enough to Forget, Ready for the Whole Day - At 4.3 g per aid, these hearing aids for seniors are about 10% lighter than Beyond Pro. The slimmer body stays clear of glasses from morning to night, while the IP67 rating handles dust, sweat and light rain on walks and workouts. Swap the receiver to match your ear

Stream Music, Video and Calls in Sync – Bluetooth 5.3 pairs with iPhone (iOS 15 or later) and Android (8.0 or later) for music, podcasts, video and hands-free calls, with audio arriving in under 8.5 ms so voices stay in step with the picture. Built-in Auracast broadcast audio tunes into shared sound in supported venues, where available. Please note: connects as a standard Bluetooth device, not an Apple MFi hearing aid, all hearing adjustments are made in the ELEHEAR app.

picks.title: Beyond 2 Pro OTC Hearing Aids for Seniors, 39% Clearer Speech
feature_bullets: Smarter Sound for Everyday Hearing - VocClear 3.0 does two jobs at once: target speech enhancement lifts the voice you're actually listening to out of a noisy restaurant or a room full of talk, while upgraded feedback suppression helps these hearing aids cut the whistling when you hug someone, put on a hat, or turn your head. Automatic, nothing to press

Stream Music, Video and Calls in Sync – The hearing aids use Bluetooth 5.3 pairs with iPhone (iOS 15 or later) and Android (8.0 or later) for music, podcasts, video and hands-free calls, with audio arriving in under 8.5 ms so voices stay in step with the picture. Built-in Auracast broadcast audio tunes into shared sound in supported venues, where available. Please note: connects as a standard Bluetooth device, not an Apple MFi hearing aid, all hearing adjustments are made in the ELEHEAR app.

Professional Hearing Care, Built In– ElePro Basic comes with every Beyond 2 Pro: take a self-guided hearing test in the ELEHEAR app, and a licensed hearing professional reviews your results and sends recommended adjustments remotely. Want more? ElePro Plus is an optional upgrade, offering a 45-minute live 1-on-1 video session for real-time fine-tuning in everyday environments (available in 27 U.S. states – contact us to confirm availability in your state).
